population: public Solana PoCs (held-out split; eval/solana-poc): judged contest PoCs and exploit-by-construction tests. Cells with n<5 (any language) are counts only. The test-suite measurement is eval/solana/RESULTS.md.
fresh_policy: A cell lifts its rule's severity only when `fresh` is true: labels from a sealed slice (V1/V2/FINAL) opened once by the frozen binary under test. A cell without `fresh` is not fresh. The floor (error: fresh Wilson 95% lower bound >= 0.80 with n >= 16; warn: >= 0.50 with n >= 10; else note) is applied at build time by crates/rg-rules/build.rs.
